description: Business days and public holidays: check if a date is a business day, add or subtract N business days, count business days between dates, or list holidays, for 250 countries, 630 subdivisions (e.g. US-NY, GB-ENG) and 31 stock exchanges, 2025-2030. Use for payment due dates, T+N settlement, delivery estimates and SLAs. Data: python-holidays (MIT). Signed receipt. Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"calendar":"US-NY","op":"add","date":"2026-12-23","days":"3"}.

calendar.description: ISO country (US), country-subdivision (US-NY) or exchange (FIN-XNYS); default US

name: business_days

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: Business-day answer for the calendar: is_business_day / result date / count / holiday list, with coverage years

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: Business Days and Holidays
